sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B AI Agent: Fast On-Device Model Guide [2026]
sources.snippet: Running a capable AI agent used to mean renting a cloud GPU and sending your data to someone else's server. LFM2.5-24B-A2B changes that equation: it is an open-weight reasoning model from Liquid AI that holds 24 billion parameters but activates only 2 billion for each token, so it can think, call tools, and finish multi-step tasks on hardware you control. sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-Base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is the largest model in the family: a 24B-parameter mixture of experts with only 2B active parameters. It builds on LFM2-24B-A2B with a 131K context window, a vocabulary doubled to 128K tokens, and pre-training scaled up from ~17T to ~33T tokens. Find more information about LFM2.5-24B-A2B in our blog post.
